tasks.title: Sensitive Data Exposure in AnalyzeTargetConfig
tasks.description: Hardcoded local dev paths and git remote URLs embedded in frontend config source.
tasks.actionGuide: Replace literal paths with generic placeholders and move dev-specific values to environment config.

tasks.title: Mock User Data in dataServer.ts
tasks.description: Mock user object containing email literal (local@simplebeacon.ai) returned in JSON response.
tasks.actionGuide: Tokenize or remove mock user objects before production bundling; gate behind dev-only flags.

tasks.title: Test Fixture Token in Archive
tasks.description: JWT-style test token committed inside an archived test fixture.
tasks.actionGuide: Move token to .env.test or add coming-soon/archive/ to .simplebeaconignore.

tasks.title: Hardcoded API Server Fallback URL
tasks.description: Literal fallback URL http://127.0.0.1:55000 in VS Code extension provider.
tasks.actionGuide: Move fallback to package.json configuration contribution instead of source literal.

tasks.title: Missing Security Header Verification
tasks.description: UI references security-headers scan category but backend CSP/HSTS coverage is unverified.
tasks.actionGuide: Add helmet middleware or reverse-proxy rules to emit CSP, X-Frame-Options, and HSTS.

tasks.title: Debug console.log in analyze-directory.js
tasks.description: Banner and stats output via console.log in CLI analyzer.
tasks.actionGuide: Gate output behind a --verbose flag or SILENT environment variable.

tasks.title: Empty catch Blocks in authService.js
tasks.description: Error-swallowing catch blocks suppress auth failures silently.
tasks.actionGuide: Replace empty catches with console.warn, telemetry, or re-throw logic.

tasks.title: Unlabeled Checkbox Inputs in HelpView
tasks.description: Checkbox inputs missing aria-label or explicit label for association.
tasks.actionGuide: Add aria-label attributes or wrap inputs in properly bound <label for=...> elements.

tasks.title: Hardcoded OpenAI Model List in Dev Server
tasks.description: Mock response embeds gpt-4 and gpt-3.5-turbo model names in dev server source.
tasks.actionGuide: Fetch model list dynamically from provider API or move to environment-driven config.
